name: R053-ai-clefable-metronome-focus-energy
why: Challenge 7. The AI's Clefable (389: Metronome, Double Team, Reflect, Follow Me; Leftovers) is the foe of the player's Shuckle 528 (Attack 10, cannot hurt it; Sandstorm / Dig / Flash / Double Team). The script plays Flash (slot 2) 16 turns, then Salamence 753 (Aerial Ace never misses, so no Double Team stack stalls the end) is switched in and plays Aerial Ace. Every AI Metronome call is a draw of one of the 336 callable moves (1 in 336). R053: Metronome calls Focus Energy; the AI's next scoring reads its own Focus Energy flag. Chance per seed about 0.03.
